summary: A Clinton Library photocopy lists Epstein and Maxwell together on a pre-event guest list for the September 29, 1993 White House donors reception.
detail: A page headed 'WHITE HOUSE DONORS RECEPTION - September 29, 1993,' marked 'Clinton Presidential Library Photocopy,' lists 'Mr. Jeffrey Epstein & Ms. Ghislaine Maxwell.' The report date is September 28, one day before the event, so the page establishes their joint inclusion on the pre-event list, not an actual WAVES admission or gate check-in. The artifact is a screenshot-grade primary record reproduced through a Daily Beast article; the complete archival file was not retrieved. It strengthens the documentary basis for finding #13880 but does not answer whether Epstein attended the September 13 signing and does not upgrade the four unpublished WAVES rows.
